messages:
Ben (Sales): FYI getting pressure from Arcadia Systems procurement. They're asking for a one-time onboarding concession + extended terms to sign a 12mo Dedicated reservation. Need quick internal decision.
Aisha (Revenue Ops): Send the ask and proposed numbers. We need duration, discount %, and whether they want pre-bill credits or invoice credits.
Ben (Sales): Ask: 12mo, 4x A100-equivalent, list $60k/mo. Request: 18% onboarding credit applied to months 1-2 (credit on invoice) + Net45 billing. They also want a 30% price protection clause for first 6 months.
Marcus (Finance): Net45 on a new Dedicated mid-market customer is risky. Also 18% > standard playbook. What's the ARR impact?
Ben (Sales): They claim ramp to steady-state in month 4. If we do 18% x 2 months, one-time hit ~ $21,600. Annualized contract value still positive. Close probability goes from 40% -> 80% per AE.
Leah (Customer Success): Arcadia needs an SRE onboarding window and an extra model conversion runbook. We'll commit to 10 engineer-hours per month for month 1-2. That cost should be factored.
Evan (Accounting): If we give invoice credits, they will offset AR; need to confirm revenue recognition with RevOps. Also Net45 means delayed cash; cash impact matters.
Aisha (Revenue Ops): Proposed mitigations: counter-offer Net30, 15% onboarding credit applied as an invoice credit, and require a 1-month security deposit held by Accounting until month 3. Also disallow price-protection clause (we don't want retro pricing).
LegalBot: Auto-note: Any concession >15% triggers concession addendum + disclosure to quarter close. If we accept, addendum must include a clawback if usage < 50% projected in first 60 days. Also exclude long-term price-protection language.
Priya (CFO): I'm comfortable with 15% onboarding credit + Net30 + 1-month deposit if NPV impact < $30k and CS confirms the 10 engineer-hours are available without overtime. Marcus, can you run the quick cash/NPV calc?
Marcus (Finance): Will do. Quick back-of-envelope: list ARR ~$720k. Two-month 15% credit = $36k gross credit? wait recalculating: 60k/mo * 2 months * 15% = $18k. With deposit and Net30, cash hit limited. I'll post numbers in 45m.
Ben (Sales): Customer pushing for 18% but said they'll accept 15% if we grant Net45. They prefer longer payment. Can we be flexible?
Evan (Accounting): If they insist on Net45, require ACH mandate + PO + 30% upfront prepayment. Otherwise stick to Net30 + deposit.
Aisha (Revenue Ops): I'll draft concession addendum language with the clawback: "If cumulative consumption in days 1-60 is < 50% of committed baseline, Redwood may invoice the difference between credited amount and actual consumption at list price; customer will pay within Net30."
Leah (Customer Success): Confirmed we can staff the 10 engineer-hours within current roadmap (no overtime).
Priya (CFO): Okay. Decision: Approve 15% onboarding credit for months 1-2, Net30 billing, 1-month security deposit, and concession addendum with clawback. Approval contingent on Marcus posting the NPV < $30k calc and Legal signing the addendum. Ben - try to close with that language.
Ben (Sales): Thanks all. I'll present to Arcadia and push for LOI today. If they still insist on Net45, will escalate. :thumbsup:
Marcus (Finance): Posted calc: one-time revenue impact $18k; NPV @10% discount over 12mo ~= $16.5k. Under threshold.
LegalBot: Addendum draft uploaded to Drive and shared with Ben + Aisha.
Aisha (Revenue Ops): I'll coordinate final contract redline and route to Priya for sign-off once Legal confirms.
Ben (Sales): Closing notes: Arcadia asked for an explicit onboarding acceptance test to release the credit. We'll add that to the SOW.
Priya (CFO): Good. Approve conditionally; sign-off once addendum and deposit term are in the contract.
